context: A teen catches up with her aunt about life changes through the seasons
purpose: Teach: 一月/四月/五月/昼間/最中/いつの間にか/あっという間に/果たして

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: おばさん、久しぶり！一月に会ってから、もう半年経つんだね。
lines.en: Auntie, it's been a while! It's already been half a year since we met in January.
lines.style: Warm casual teen greeting, slightly nostalgic and bubbly tone

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 本当にあっという間に時間が過ぎるわね。さくらちゃん、また背が伸びたんじゃない？
lines.en: Time really flies by in a flash. Sakura-chan, didn't you get taller again?
lines.style: Affectionate aunt tone, gentle and observant, slightly teasing

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そうなの！四月に高校生になってから、なんかいろいろ変わった気がする。
lines.en: Right! Since I became a high schooler in April, somehow a lot of things feel different.
lines.style: Excited teenage voice, animated and self-reflective expression

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 五月の連休のあとが大変だって言うじゃない？授業の最中に眠くなったりしなかった？
lines.en: They say after Golden Week in May is tough — didn't you get sleepy during class?
lines.style: Caring aunt asking with concern, knowing and conversational tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それがね、五月病になりかけたよ。昼間ずっとぼーっとしてて、自分でも果たしてついていけるか不安だった。
lines.en: Actually, I nearly got the May blues. I was spacing out all afternoon, wondering whether I could keep up.
lines.style: Confessional teen tone, slightly dramatic but honest and vulnerable

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: そうだったの。でも、いつの間にか慣れていくものよ。私も新しい仕事を始めた時はそうだったし。
lines.en: Is that so. But before you know it, you get used to it. I was the same when I started my new job.
lines.style: Reassuring elder voice, warm and grounded with personal anecdote

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: おばさんの仕事ってどんな感じ？最近忙しいの？
lines.en: What's your job like, Auntie? Have you been busy lately?
lines.style: Curious teen pivoting to show interest, sincere and engaged

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 夏は特にね。気づいたら秋になってそう。今度ゆっくりお茶でもしながら話しましょう。
lines.en: Summer especially. Before I know it, it'll probably be autumn. Let's chat over tea sometime soon.
lines.style: Soft closing aunt tone, inviting and warm with seasonal wistfulness
